map.依据《工伤保险条例》计算工伤伤残待遇: Computes work injury disability benefits under the Work Injury Insurance Regulations
map.📖 查看「工伤赔偿计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Work Injury Compensation Calculator User Guide"
map.一次性伤残补助金 = 伤残月数(1级27…10级7) × 本人工资; 1–4级伤: Lump-sum disability grant = months by grade, 27 at grade 1 down to 7 at grade 10, × the employee's own wage; disability allowance for grades 1-4 = own wage × (90%/85%/80%/75%)
map.一次性伤残补助金按伤残等级对应月数（一级27个月递减至十级7个月）乘以本人工资；: The lump-sum disability grant multiplies the months for the grade, 27 at grade 1 down to 7 at grade 10, by the employee's own wage. For grades 1 to 4 the employment relationship continues but the employee leaves the post, receiving a monthly disability allowance of 75% to 90% of that wage. For grades 5 to 10, on termination of the relationship a one-off work injury medical subsidy and a disability employment subsidy are also payable, based on the average monthly wage of employees in the pooling region for the previous year, with the number of months set locally.
map.一次性伤残补助金（本人工资）: Lump-sum disability grant, as a multiple of the own wage
map.伤残津贴（本人工资）: Disability allowance, as a share of the own wage
map.职工被认定工伤并评定伤残等级后，测算一次性伤残补助金、伤残津贴等。: Once an injury is confirmed as work related and a disability grade assigned, work out the lump-sum grant and the disability allowance.
map.一至四级保留劳动关系、退出岗位，按月发伤残津贴（90%–75% 本人工资）。: For grades 1 to 4 the employment relationship continues but the employee leaves the post, receiving a monthly allowance of 75% to 90% of their wage.
map.五至十级解除/终止合同的，另算一次性医疗与就业补助金。: For grades 5 to 10, on termination the one-off medical and employment subsidies are added.
map.一次性伤残补助金 = 11 个月本人工资（八级对应 11 个月）；本人工资 80: The lump-sum grant equals 11 months of the employee's own wage, since grade 8 corresponds to 11 months; on a wage of ¥8,000 that is 8000 × 11 = ¥88,000, with medical and employment subsidies in addition.
map.一至四级按月发伤残津贴，一级为本人工资 90%；工资 8000 → 7200 元: Grades 1 to 4 receive a monthly allowance, with grade 1 at 90% of the wage; on ¥8,000 that is ¥7,200 a month, switching to the pension scheme on retirement.
map.一次性伤残补助金月数怎么定？: How are the months for the lump-sum grant set?
map.一级 27 个月递减至十级 7 个月；具体月数按《工伤保险条例》对应伤残等级确定: They run from 27 months at grade 1 down to 7 months at grade 10, fixed by the corresponding grade under the Work Injury Insurance Regulations.
map.没签合同能认定工伤吗？: Can an injury be confirmed as work related without a contract?
map.能，存在事实劳动关系即可申请工伤认定，需工资流水、考勤、同事证言等证明劳动关系。: Yes. A de facto employment relationship is enough to apply for confirmation, proved by wage records, attendance records and colleagues' statements.
